title: Dollar Rises
subtitle: The dollar rose nearly 1% compared to the real on a day of global unrest
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The dollar rose nearly 1% compared to the real on Thursday. The US currency gained strength abroad.

This occurred amid risk aversion caused by tensions in the Middle East and the rise in oil prices.

Dollar Value

The dollar closed above $5.22.

With information from Agência Brasil.
